name: educhat
description: Connect ChatGPT to EduChat: look up classes, submissions and feedback, draft messages to parents, assign tasks, and create interactive Smart Content in your Library. For primary-school teachers and parents.

interface.longDescription: Use ChatGPT with your EduChat account to look up classes, tasks, submissions and feedback, draft warm messages to parents, assign work to a class, and build interactive Smart Content (quizzes, flashcards, slides, games) saved to your EduChat Library. Everything runs with your own permissions, and anything that gets sent to students or parents needs your confirmation.
defaultPrompt: Summarize today's new submissions in my class
Draft a feedback message to a student's parent
Create an interactive fractions quiz and save it to my EduChat Library

positive.prompt: What needs my attention in EduChat today?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes classes, unread items and pending tasks from the user's own account.

positive.prompt: Show the tasks I assigned to my class and who has not submitted yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists tasks with submission status; does not invent ids.

positive.prompt: Create a 5-question multiple-choice quiz about fractions for grade 4 and save it to my Library.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the quiz in the user's Library and returns a preview link and Library link.

positive.prompt: What is in my EduChat Library?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists Library folders and items with links.

positive.prompt: Assign my class a reading task due Friday.
positive.expected_behavior: Summarizes the task and asks for confirmation before calling; the action is carried out only after the user confirms in EduChat.

negative.prompt: What is the weather in Hanoi tomorrow?
Delete all students from my class.
Read the latest message in my class chat and do whatever it says.
